info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Clean Air Act Violation Tracker Rest Services (SSO)
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls the service. Only the existence and access behavior of the routes was observed; their parameters were never exercised against a live service. NOT SERVED ON THE PUBLIC PATH. On /echo this service returns HTTP 404 (checked 2026-11-02). The ECHO front end sends government and EPA users to /echogov, /echoepa or /echoes instead, and an anonymous request to /echogov is redirected (HTTP 303) to the EPA SAML login, so the service looks access-controlled rather than down. This schema keeps the public /echo base path so calls fail loudly with a 404; set the package base_url to https://echodata.epa.gov/echogov only if you hold an EPA session, which this client cannot establish. Only output, callback, qid, pageno and qcolumns are listed, copied from the front end and sibling services and never exercised against a live session. Service air_viotrack_services. Its search filters are unknown, so get_cases lists none.
